description: Display (144Hz Curved AMOLED Display) : A screen that melts into the edges. Ultra-responsive. Flicker-free. Made to move with you, whether you’re scrolling, gaming, or simply vibing. India's Slimmest 7.45mm Curve : The design is crafted to feel like the future with it's starship-inspired design. Segment's 1st AI : Smart that actually feels smart. Meet ELLA, segment's 1st AI with Indian^ language support, voice-print supression, auto-call answering, and call-assistance. It helps you work faster, create better, and stay secure. Fun. Efficient. Private. Just like it should be. India's 1st No Network Communication* : Your phone shouldn’t lose touch just because your carrier does, meet India's 1st No Network Communication* - up to 800m Smartphone. The dual-pass VoWiFi makes sure your calls don’t drop, your downloads don’t stall, and your streaming doesn’t stutter. And with the Intelligent Signal Hub System, your phone constantly finds and locks onto the best signal path.
